sources.title: Pythia-160m Review, Pricing & Alternatives 2026 | AI Indigo
sources.snippet: Pythia-160m is a compact transformer-based language model developed by EleutherAI, designed to deliver balanced performance for natural language tasks while maintaining computational efficiency. With 160 million parameters, this model serves as a foundational tool for researchers and developers requiring quick inference and minimal resource usage.
